SECTION A: Multiple Choice Questions (1 Mark Each)

Q2. Arrange the following events in chronological order and choose the correct option:  

I. Napoleon invades Italy  
II. Unification of Germany  
III. Victor Emmanuel II declared King of United Italy  
IV. Fall of Napoleon  
Option:  
(A) I, IV, III, II  
(B) I, IV, II, III  
(C) IV, I, III, II  
(D) IV, I, II, III

Answer / Solution:
Arrange the following events in chronological order and choose the correct option: 
(A) I, IV, III, II 
Reasoning: 
▪ I. Napoleon invades Italy (1797) 
▪  
IV. Fall of Napoleon (1815) 
▪  
III. Victor Emmanuel II declared King of United Italy (1861) 
▪  
II. Unification of Germany (1871)
